title: Growing up among Henderson's seasoned sidemen
summary: He felt he matured in Henderson's band, learning road experience from veterans like Pop Smith, Coleman Hawkins, Buster Bailey and Harvey Boone.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: maturing, you know. I was growing up and I was pretty much of a man by then, a man amongst men, because all these fellows who were in Fletcher's band, they had been around quite a bit. And I got to hear all the stories they used to tell about like Pop Smith and, you know, Coleman, Buster Bailey, and one of the other saxophone players, Harvey Boone. Used to tell us stories, you know, and I picked up on all the experiences, and they know how to handle themselves on the road and all that sort of thing. You know, I learned all that sort of thing.
